sample_size: prior_season_games + observed_games; cutoff-known raw appearances, not effective independent sample size
tuning_objective: equal-season next-four-week points per pick, all_late_price cohort
tuning_tie_break: within 1e-10: smaller weight, then larger half_life; zero correction represented once
candidate_rule: unchanged pilot: current-week RB offense, 100 < preseason ADP <= 300, trailing PPG < 12; at least three candidates
target_horizon: next four calendar weeks including byes and absences
advancement_threshold_note: Working research threshold chosen before this run, not an established acquisition-profit threshold; passing only merits prospective testing.
